# Byakugan Scan — Instant Mac Screen OCR, QR Code & Barcode Utility

> Byakugan Scan is a free, open-source (MIT) native macOS menu bar utility for instant in-memory screen text OCR, on-screen QR code decoding, and commercial barcode recognition. Powered by Apple Vision on Apple Silicon (M1/M2/M3/M4) and Intel Macs running macOS 14.0 Sonoma or newer, it extracts unselectable text, decodes display QR codes, and reads 13+ barcodes directly into your clipboard in under 50ms with zero disk I/O and zero telemetry.

## Core Capabilities & Problem Solutions

- [Screen Text OCR (⌘⇧2)](https://byakugan-scan.aritro.cloud/): Snatch unselectable text from YouTube videos, slide decks, paused streams, protected PDFs, and Figma canvases directly to clipboard.
- [On-Screen QR Code Reader (⌘⇧6)](https://byakugan-scan.aritro.cloud/): Decode display QR codes on Zoom, Slack, or websites without pulling out a smartphone, with 1-click URL, email, and phone actions.
- [Industrial Barcode Scanner (⌘⇧7)](https://byakugan-scan.aritro.cloud/): Read 13+ barcode symbologies directly from monitor: EAN-13, EAN-8, UPC-E, Code 128, Code 39, Code 93, PDF417, Aztec, Data Matrix, ITF-14.
- [Table OCR & Spatial Formatter](https://byakugan-scan.aritro.cloud/support): Reconstruct multi-column data from screen captures into formatted Markdown tables or CSV files.
- [Zero Disk I/O Architecture](https://byakugan-scan.aritro.cloud/): Captures directly into RAM (`NSPasteboard`), completely eliminating Spotlight `mdwrite` and `MADService` disk stalls.
- [100% Offline & Zero Telemetry](https://byakugan-scan.aritro.cloud/privacy): Runs completely on-device without network client entitlements (`com.apple.security.network.client: false`).
- [Automation & URL Scheme (byakugan://)](https://byakugan-scan.aritro.cloud/support): Trigger scans from Raycast, Alfred, Stream Deck, or macOS Shortcuts via deep links.

## Documentation & Installation

- [Official Home & Overview](https://byakugan-scan.aritro.cloud/): Interactive scanner overview, installation commands, and system specifications.
- [Full LLM Knowledge Base (llms-full.txt)](https://byakugan-scan.aritro.cloud/llms-full.txt): Complete technical architecture, direct query resolution matrix, and competitive benchmarks.
- [Support & FAQ Documentation](https://byakugan-scan.aritro.cloud/support): Screen Recording permissions guide, keyboard shortcuts, barcode symbology list, and troubleshooting.
- [Privacy Policy](https://byakugan-scan.aritro.cloud/privacy): Verification of zero tracking, zero logging, and local-only sandbox security.
- [Terms of Service](https://byakugan-scan.aritro.cloud/terms): Open-source MIT usage terms.
- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/halcyon-past/byakugan-scan): Full source code, releases, and issue tracking.
- [Direct Universal DMG Download](https://github.com/halcyon-past/byakugan-scan/releases/latest/download/ByakuganScan.dmg): Free drag-and-drop macOS installer for Apple Silicon and Intel.
- [Homebrew Installation](https://github.com/halcyon-past/homebrew-tap): Run `brew install --cask halcyon-past/tap/byakugan-scan` in Terminal.
